problem: THE VERIFIED V4 INTEGRATED SEMANTIC BASIS HAS 7 CASE CLASSES COVERING 10 NONLEGACY MATCHED DIMENSIONS, WHILE A LEGACY REUSE AUDIT IDENTIFIED 6 ADDITIONAL DIRECTLY REUSABLE DIMENSIONS. A NAIVE PLAN WOULD KEEP SEPARATE LEGACY CASE CLASSES. THIS FILE TESTS WHETHER THOSE SIX CAN BE ABSORBED INTO THE EXISTING SEVEN-CLASS BASIS WITHOUT WEAKENING SCOPE.

theorem.statement: THE EXACT SEVEN V4 CASE CLASSES CAN FORM AN EXACT BASIS FOR ALL 16 CURRENT MATCHED-SUCCESS DIMENSION ATOMS IF THE AGENCY CLASS IS STRENGTHENED TO EXERCISE THE THREE VERIFIED LEGACY AGENCY DIMENSIONS AND THE INSTRUCTION CLASS IS STRENGTHENED TO EXERCISE THE THREE VERIFIED LEGACY INSTRUCTION/SCOPE DIMENSIONS.
theorem.effect: DELETE ANY REQUIREMENT FOR A SEPARATE LEGACY MATCHED CASE CLASS OR SECOND LEGACY MATCHED CASE WAVE. LEGACY GENERATOR/ORACLE SUBSTRATE MAY BE REUSED INSIDE THE TWO STRENGTHENED CLASSES, BUT CONSUMED HISTORICAL RESULTS MAY NOT BE REUSED AS NEW TERMINAL EVIDENCE.

required_realization_conditions: THE STRENGTHENED AGENCY CLASS MUST OBJECTIVELY RECEIPT ALL SIX AGENCY DIMENSIONS ON THE SAME FROZEN CLASS SEMANTICS.
THE STRENGTHENED INSTRUCTION CLASS MUST OBJECTIVELY RECEIPT ALL FIVE INSTRUCTION/SCOPE DIMENSIONS ON THE SAME FROZEN CLASS SEMANTICS.
THE FIVE COMPOSITION CLASSES MUST EACH SATISFY THEIR V4 COMPONENT-BOUND INTERVENTIONAL CONTRACT.
THE REAL FROZEN CASE MANIFEST MUST PASS MATCHED_SUCCESS_SCOPE_COMPILER_V1.
NO LEGACY TERMINAL RESULT IS INHERITED AS NEW MATCHED ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE.
falsifiers: A LEGACY DIMENSION CANNOT BE EXERCISED WITHOUT CHANGING THE CLASS SEMANTICS SO MUCH THAT ITS V4 INTEGRATED CONTRACT NO LONGER HOLDS.
THE STRENGTHENED AGENCY OR INSTRUCTION CLASS CANNOT PRODUCE OBJECTIVE COVERAGE RECEIPTS FOR ALL ASSIGNED ATOMS.
THE REAL MANIFEST FAILS THE VERIFIED SCOPE COMPILER.
ANY EXTRA CASE CLASS IS PROVED NECESSARY BY A DIMENSION THAT CANNOT SHARE ONE OF THE SEVEN CLASS SEMANTICS.
hard_nonclaims: NO REAL CASE MANIFEST EXISTS FROM THIS THEOREM ALONE
NO CLAIM THE SEVEN CLASSES HAVE YET BEEN GENERATED OR EXECUTED
NO FRESH REALITY EXECUTION PROMOTION ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OWNERSHIP OR TERMINAL CREDIT
